chapters.title: The Same Knot
chapters.synopsis: Priya reads a glyph in which ask and finish are the same word, and watches Calder watch Ivo.

chapters.title: Lullaby
chapters.synopsis: Root nuns sing a broken Keeper lullaby. Science and tactics each save a life, and neither man says thank you cleanly.

chapters.title: Pencil Shavings
chapters.synopsis: Rain lifts Calder's blocker for one breath. A classroom tries to surface. He cannot hold it.

chapters.title: Ask It Something
chapters.synopsis: A Mirror Hind wears Sable's posture. Ellis asks it a question, and the mimic fails.

chapters.title: Six Hours
chapters.synopsis: Rhee admits she sat on a Helix transmission. The delay will choose the ground for the fight to come.

chapters.title: Cardamom
chapters.synopsis: Ivo sleeps on his notes. Calder covers him with a jacket and calls it asset management.

chapters.title: Cache the Metal
chapters.synopsis: Harun goes down the Cistern Stair without his gun. The eels are guarding silence. Pavel's voice is still on the stylus.

chapters.title: The Gallery
chapters.synopsis: Ivo crosses a cracked span for a verb. The stone goes. In the collapse he says Calder has always been like this.

chapters.title: Ivo
chapters.synopsis: The classroom returns. Calder speaks the name he never used kindly. Ivo goes still.
